item.title: Ibusuki Nanohana (Rape Blossom) Season — Guide
item.description: Thanks to its warm, mild subtropical climate at the southern tip of the Satsuma Peninsula, the Ibusuki area sees its bright yellow rape blossoms (nanohana) bloom remarkably early — around January and February, in the depths of winter elsewhere in Japan. During this season, fields and roadsides around Ibusuki are carpeted in cheerful golden flowers, a warming splash of early colour set against the mild coastal scenery, the sea and the conical Mount Kaimon (‘Satsuma Fuji’).
